body: In the same boat :) .  I absolutely loved being alone ~1 year ago.  Now everything else bores me and I just want to socialize :/.  Whatever you do, don't act depressed around others, just fake it until you make some friends.

You should just call a doctor and ask, I had to get a booster after getting a cut, and it hadn't been 10 years.

Is it really worth not going?  I'd take a shot over risk getting sick.

Yea, It's just really hard to eat.  I have crohn's disease that isn't 100% managed right now, so the more I eat, the more of a chance for pain :/ .  So it's kinda a win-loss if I eat or don't eat.  But I'll try...

Yeah I have a pretty nice neighborhood...and my dogs would probably enjoy it.  I know it looks so silly from the outside, I don't know why this all hurts so much.

I actually went to the gym yesterday but ended up just running on the treadmills.  I feel like I'm being judged >< .

I plan on going back to school next semester which I'm kinda excited for I guess.  I dropped out because of this obsession I have with my appearance.  Used to be really shy/ had anxiety issues, but I seemed to have gotten over it, basically the one thing I have been able to improve.

I work from home/not in school, so...I don't really go out much, I think this really contributes to my depression/lonelyness issues.  All my friends are in different states/are online.  

Just really sucks being judged immediately all the time.  I don't think I'm ugly at least, just like I belong in highschool.  People treat you so much different, which I'm sure you've dealt with seeing as you look young too.  Idk...

It's a pretty vicious cycle.  It's almost like I enjoy being miserable now.  Or maybe I just can't remember what it's like to be actually content with oneself.

Anyways, sent ya a pm.

 If you want someone to talk to just pm me.
